name: Gemini
description: Gemini is Google DeepMind's family of AI models, positioned as "frontier intelligence" for building and using intelligent agents that reason across text, images, video, and audio.
best_for: Google positions Gemini across segments — developers/engineers (via API and agentic coding), enterprises (via an Agent Platform for automation), knowledge workers (document analysis/reasoning), and general consumers (via the Gemini app).
